text:
There is a specific kind of chaos that ensues when a three-pound ball of fluff decides it is the apex predator of the neighborhood. My neighbor’s "Beware of Dog" sign was clearly a psychological warfare tactic, but the postman, bless his heart, played right into it with that sarcastic "Oh no, I'm so scared!" comment. That was the moment my dog’s entire worldview shifted. He no longer saw himself as a lap dog; he saw himself as a misunderstood warrior who had been underestimated by the mail carrier. Now, every time the postman approaches, my little guy doesn’t just bark; he launches himself with the kinetic energy of a cannonball, convinced he is on a sacred mission to dismantle the postman’s fear and prove his dominance. It’s adorable, terrifying, and completely unnecessary, but hey, at least the postman is never bored.

The color of an eggplant is purple.
